ai_overview.text: Excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis) is treated in Guntur through specialized dermatology clinics and multi-specialty hospitals. Common local options include prescription antiperspirants, oral medications, and targeted clinical procedures like Botox injections . Instagram · b18skinclinic +3 Treatment Options Topical Care: Prescription-strength antiperspirants containing aluminum chloride or specialized creams to block sweat glands. Medications: Oral pills like anticholinergics to reduce overall nerve signals to sweat glands. Injections: Botox (botulinum toxin) injections for fast, effective, and temporary relief from focal sweating in areas like palms, feet, or underarms. Advanced/Surgical Procedures: Ionophoresis, laser treatments, or surgical options for severe cases.
